  Scenario: AC13 Error answers 401, 403 and 404 (provided operations)
    Given a request to a provided operation of RWB-S2-E3002-CON
    When the request carries no valid credentials, lacks the right, or names a treatment that does not exist
    Then the system answers 401, 403 or 404 for the matching cause, and the message is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S2-E3004-APP-AC13)

  Scenario: AC14 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write with an Idempotency-Key has already been answered
    When the same write is replayed with that Idempotency-Key
    Then the first answer is returned and no second offer, decision record or timer is created

  Scenario: AC15 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event
    Given an event that the workflow has already consumed
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then it is not processed a second time and no second effect is recorded

  Scenario: AC16 Activity retry and timeout
    Given an activity of the workflow fails or does not finish in time
    When the activity is retried or times out
    Then the retry and the timeout follow the activity's policy and the outcome is recorded once; the retry count and the timeout are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S2-E3004-APP-AC16)

  Scenario: AC17 Disallowed status change refused
    Given a status change the model does not allow
    When the change is requested
    Then the change is refused and nothing changes
